title: feat(plugin-list): the empty-state "Clear filters" also clears the user-filter chips
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb7Lo3k5A85iWVZxQVoCv6Ht)_

Fixes #29052

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：列表只被用户筛选标签（列表上方的快速筛选 chips）筛空时，空状态现在也给出「清除筛选」主按钮，和被筛选面板、「在队列中」开关筛空时一致；点一下连同面板条件、队列开关、搜索词一起把标签清掉，记录回来，地址栏里的 `uf_*` 参数也一并清掉，刷新后不会再回来。`UserFilters` 新增一个可选的 `ref`（导出类型 `UserFiltersHandle`，只有 `clear()` 一个方法），不传 ref 的宿主行为完全不变。预设标签页（tabs）不算读者的筛选，不清。
- **为什么改**：#28908 落地后，被标签单独筛空的列表文案仍说「试试调整或清除筛选」，按钮却只有「添加记录」；原因是标签的选择状态藏在组件内部，列表无法从外部清除，又不允许用 key 重挂载。
- **风险与回滚**：低。选择状态仍归 `UserFilters` 自己，不重挂载；`clear()` 等同于逐个点每个标签的 ×，走同一条 `onFilterChange`/`onSelectionsChange` 路径，宿主按字段删除 URL 参数，宿主代码未改。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`（`UserFiltersHandle` 与 `DropdownFilters` 里的 `commitSelection`/`useImperativeHandle`）；`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`handleClearReaderQuery` 与 `userFilterChipsClearable`）；新测试 `ListView.clearFiltersChips-29052.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.clearFiltersChips-29052.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例全部通过；第一个用例断言主按钮是「Clear filters」、点击后标签的 × 消失、空状态消失、宿主收到 `{ status: [], rating: [] }`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`UserFilters` can be cleared from outside, without a remount.** It takes an optional `ref` (React 19 ref-as-prop) that receives a `UserFiltersHandle` while a dropdown or toggle bar is mounted; the type is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-list` beside `UserFiltersProps`. Its one method, `clear()`, empties every chip, author `defaultValues` included, exactly as pressing each chip's × would:

- dropdown: the selection becomes empty for every chip field, `onFilterChange` receives no conditions, and `onSelectionsChange` reports **every chip field** with an empty selection, held or not. The per-chip × path and `clear()` now share one commit helper (`commitSelection`), so typing finality, the emit and the host report cannot drift apart;
- toggle (stored, spec-deprecated): every toggle turns off and no conditions are emitted;
- tabs: no handle is set. A preset tab is one of the view's presets, not a filter the reader added.

The selection stays the bar's own state. A host that passes no ref gets today's bar unchanged (pinned below). No key remount (ui/AGENTS.md #8), no new metadata key or option.

**`ListView`'s "Clear filters" covers the chips.** `handleClearReaderQuery` (from #28908) now also calls the bar's `clear()`. The empty state offers the action when the chip bar is on screen, is not in tabs mode, and its conditions are part of the applied query (`userFilterChipsClearable`), beside the existing panel and queue-toggle arms. So a list emptied by a chip alone now shows "Clear filters" as the primary action and "Add record" as the secondary, and the existing copy ("No records match your current filters or search. Try adjusting or clearing them.") now matches the action offered. No copy changed.

**What the host persists.** Measured by reading the hosts on `origin/main` `2af0ae2a`: all three hosts (`objectViewListUrlState.ts` `handleUserFilterSelectionsChange`, `InterfaceListPage`, `ObjectDataPage`) write the report through `applyUserFilterParams`, which deletes `uf_FIELD` only for a field the report names with an empty selection; a field the report omits keeps its param. That is why `clear()` reports every chip field rather than `{}`: a `{}` report would leave every `uf_*` param in place, and the chips would come back on the next seed. With every field named, the existing host path drops them all, so no host file changed.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.clearFiltersChips-29052.test.tsx` (new), 4 cases: a chip restored from the host empties the list, "Clear filters" leads, the click clears the chip, the next fetch carries no miss, the rows come back and the host receives every chip field empty; an author-defaulted chip clears the same way; a chip and a panel condition together clear in one click; a list emptied by a preset tab offers no clear action.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.clearHandle-29052.test.tsx` (new), 5 cases: dropdown `clear()` (defaults included, unheld fields reported); a chip picked after a clear applies alone; toggle `clear()`; tabs set no handle; without a ref the bar restores its selection and the chip × clears in place as before.
- `ListView.emptyStateClearFilters-28908.test.tsx`: its last case pinned the chip-only list offering no clear action, the behaviour this card changes; it is removed and the header points at the new file, which pins the replacement.

## Acceptance notes

- **Preset tabs stay out of the clear.** A list emptied by a preset tab still reads "your current filters or search" with no clear action, as before this PR. Clearing a preset has no empty state of its own (with `showAllRecords: false` there is no unfiltered tab), so it is left to the view's presets. Seat 1's #28950 (branch `claude/project-thread-o05ndx`, unmerged at writing) counts the tab's conditions among its "filters" personalization part and resets them through its own `uf_*` strip and remount; the two paths do not touch each other.
- **Mechanism: a handle, not a controlled `selections` prop.** The card allowed either. A controlled selection would need the host to know the bar's effective selection, which it does not: author defaults, chips derived after the definition loads, and the late type coercion all settle inside the bar and are deliberately not echoed to the host. A host clearing to `{}` would then miss a default-only chip. The handle clears whatever the bar holds, and the declaration face still widens (one optional prop, one exported type), so the claim's `Clause-②: yes (widening)` stands.
- No docs page or README describes `UserFilters`' host props (`git grep` of `onSelectionsChange`, `initialSelections` and `UserFiltersProps` over `content/` and the package README: zero hits), so none is updated.

## Verification

Readings on `809862b9` (the change). `77aa59cd` merges `origin/main` (clean; the incoming commits touch no plugin-list file and none of the `uf_*` host files, so no re-check was owed by AGENTS.md multi-agent §10).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- New files and the touched #28908 file plus `UserFilters.test.tsx`: 4 files, 31/31 passed.
- `packages/plugin-list` in full, in two locked batches at `--maxWorkers=2`: 92 files 659 tests, and 92 files 1098 tests, all passed (184 files).
- Host consumers (`git grep -l` of `UserFilters`, `ListEmptyState`, `empty-state-clear-filters`, `filter-clear-`, `userFilterSelections`, `onUserFilterSelectionsChange` outside plugin-list: app-shell `ObjectDataPage.relationUserFilters-13310`, `ObjectView.ufViewSwitch-11992`, `userFilterUrlState.listState-11860`, plugin-grid's two empty-state files, plugin-form, plugin-view, types' two parity files): 9 files, 387 tests passed, after building the app-shell closure (64/64 tasks).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4900 tests passed.
- Ablation (one-time, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `userFiltersRef.current?.clear();` in `handleClearReaderQuery` with a no-op (`void userFiltersRef;`). The new ListView file went 3 failed / 1 passed (the three chip-clear cases red; the preset-tab case green, as it pins no clear). The restore leg read blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

</details>

- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 (no component config changed).

</details>
